body:
Blocked by: #2

### Context
PRD §26 (configuration), §11 (capability validation), §6 (minimum versions).

### Scope
- Search order: `--config`, `./mergeyard.yaml`, `~/.config/mergeyard/config.yaml`.
- Built-in defaults for every field in the §26 "full configuration" example.
- Precedence: built-in defaults → global → repository. Repository `implementer` / `reviewer` blocks override only the fields they set.
- Resolved per-repository config (role settings, base branch, concurrency, labels).
- Validation with stable `config.*` error codes (§33):
  - repo format;
  - agent is `claude` or `codex`;
  - positive, finite `max_rounds`, `max_attempts`, `concurrency`, and `usage_limits.max_waits`;
  - durations parse;
  - `agents.claude.permission_mode` is `auto`, `acceptEdits`, or `bypassPermissions`;
  - `agents.codex.sandbox` is `workspace-write` or `danger-full-access`.
- A config writer that preserves user content, used later by `init` and `repo add`.
- `mergeyard.example.yaml` at the repo root.

### Out of scope
Resolving the base branch from GitHub (when `base_branch` is unset) happens at run time (#7).

### Acceptance criteria
- Minimal config (`repositories: [{repo: …}]`) loads with all defaults from §26.
- Table-driven tests cover precedence, repository overrides, and every validation error.
- Writer round-trips a config without losing comments or unknown fields, or documents clearly why it can't.
title: [M1] Configuration: load, defaults, validation
